items.title: Define DONE milestone closeout snapshot schema and read semantics
items.context: Add a stable artifact contract for DONE closeout rows with status, solvedProblem, doneMeans, evidence, risks, nextAction, binding hashes, and source milestone_status digest.
items.userSees: The closeout JSON contains each final milestone row with Status, Solved Problem, Acceptance, Evidence, Risks, and Next Action fields.

happy.desc: A completed sample milestone report can be converted to a closeout snapshot containing every milestone with solvedProblem and evidence summary fields.

edge.desc: A closeout snapshot preserves the accepted rows even when a later live milestone_status report would become stale.

adversarial.desc: The snapshot helper refuses to create final success from incomplete or risk-bearing milestone reports.

items.title: Capture closeout snapshot during DONE advancement
items.context: Wire DONE advancement to create milestone-closeout.json from a fresh completed milestone_status projection before DONE metadata/version changes can stale the live view.
items.userSees: After DONE, the story has a milestone-closeout.json artifact generated before closure drift can affect the live diagnostic.

happy.desc: A DONE transition path writes milestone-closeout.json from a completed risk-free milestone report.

edge.desc: DONE advancement leaves a clear missing-ledger or not-applicable reason instead of fabricating a snapshot when no milestone ledger exists.

adversarial.desc: DONE advancement cannot write a closeout snapshot when milestone rows are not all completed or risks are present.

items.title: Expose stable closeout reporting to users and hosts
items.context: Add a read-only way to print the DONE closeout table from the snapshot, keeping live milestone_status available for current diagnostics.
